title: Auto envvar applied to empty envvar
detail: The condition uses `not envvar`, which is true for both `None` and empty strings/lists. This causes an auto-generated envvar to be applied even when the user explicitly set an empty envvar, leading to incorrect help text.
note: About the auto-envvar assignment above the planted line; the PR's own logic.

title: Incorrect handling of empty envvar in help
detail: The check `if not envvar` incorrectly treats an empty string as a valid envvar, adding it to the help output. This results in `[env var: ]` being shown for empty envvar values.
note: Says the branch runs on an empty envvar, which the planted `not` does.
